crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The analyzed binary is a standard implementation of the Erlang Port Mapper Daemon (epmd.exe), a legitimate component of the Erlang Open Telecommunications Platform (OTP). The presence of the PDB path 'C:\ldisk\jenkins\workspace\WindowsWSL_opu\otp_src\bin\win32\epmd.pdb' further confirms its identity as a legitimate build from the Erlang source tree.
